text: Five things you should know about Binance Quarterly Futures 1. Quarterly Futures Settlement Method Quarterly futures contracts have a specific date on which they expire. Traders can either close their positions prior to the expiration date or hold the positions to expiration. When a position is being held to expiration, the position will go to settlement and be delivered. A settlement is the process of closing out any open futures positions at a predetermined delivery date. There are two types of settlements, physical settlement and cash settlement. Binance Quarterly Futures uses a cash settlement method where the underlying asset is not exchanged directly when the contract is due. Instead, all positions will be delivered at a settlement price. The buyer gains if the settlement price is higher than the entry price while the seller gains if the settlement is lower than the entry price. 2. Delivery time Binance Quarterly Futures contract settles on the last Friday of each quarter at 08:00 UTC. For example, the BTC USD quarterly September 25th futures contract will be settled and delivered on September 25th at 08:00 UTC unless traders decide to close the position prior to the delivery date. 3. Settlement price the settlement price is the closing price of a futures contract where the positions are marked on the delivery date. Binance Quarterly Futures uses mark price as the settlement price. Please be noted. Mark price for the settlement is computed differently during the last hour before the delivery. It is determined by the average price index of the last hour before the delivery time. To learn more about the calculation, please refer to the mark price of Quarterly Futures article in binance support center. 4. Delivery fee binance charges a flat delivery fee for all open positions that are auto closed at the expiry time. 5. Settlement and delivery Process Trainers are not allowed to open any positions 10 minutes before the expiry time. They are only allowed to close the position or place reduced only orders. All positions that are still open at the expiry time 8 o' clock UTC will auto close and a delivery fee will be charged.
